name: Memory/Concentration Game
summary: Flip pairs of face-down cards to find matching pairs from memory, reinforcing associations between related concepts.

aiGenerability.notes: AI generates matching pairs with memory overlay. Same content generation as matching pairs (mechanic 8), but presented with hidden cards for memory challenge.

pairs.description: Array of matching pairs. Each pair has front and back content.

front.description: Content on first card (e.g., country name, historical date, vocabulary term).

back.description: Content on matching card (e.g., flag, event description, definition).

speedBonus.description: If true, completing quickly earns bonus points.

theme.description: Visual theme hint for AI (e.g., 'animals', 'flags', 'historical figures'). Helps with image/icon selection.

ux.mobileNotes: 3×4 grid for ages 8–10; 4×4 grid for 11–16. Cards flip with smooth 3D rotation (300ms). Matched pairs fade out or show checkmark overlay. Cards remain visible if mismatched; learner tries again.

ageAdaptations.8-10: 3×4 grid (6 pairs). Matched pairs remain visible and highlighted. No timer. Simple categories (animals, colors, shapes). Encourages pattern recognition over speed.
ageAdaptations.11-13: 4×4 grid (8 pairs). Matched pairs fade or remove after 1-2 seconds. Optional 90-second timer. Feedback shows how many pairs found and attempts taken.
ageAdaptations.14-16: 4×4 grid (8 pairs). Matched pairs remove immediately. 60-second timer with leaderboard. Strict scoring: points deducted for failed attempts. Content is more abstract (historical figures & achievements, scientific terms & definitions).
